codex_v2_findings.finding: Final result assembly follows the last deadline check
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: Complete result assembled first, then one ORIGINAL-deadline check; failure re-assembles HELD in memory (no I/O), final_deadline_check CROSSED/NOT_PERFORMED_ALREADY_CROSSED; BaseException from the check -> P5_BASE_EXCEPTION, HELD result attached, re-raised.
codex_v2_findings.residual: Not a hard real-time return guarantee; one dict store and return follow a passing check; caller-side lateness is CP1 territory.

codex_v2_findings.finding: Native commit operations lack individual completion checks
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: Full original check before each native call (crossed latch => no new I/O); per-call completion check on success AND Exception; primary event + secondary deadline cause retained separately, secondary BaseException keeps primary context; returned fd/iterator/progress/fsync completion retained BEFORE the completion check; owned closes always permitted and then checked unless crossed; deadline BaseException latches crossed.
codex_v2_findings.residual: Stalls inside a native call remain unbounded; retain hooks assumed non-raising.

codex_v2_findings.finding: Directory iterators lack protected acquisition and unresolved-resource reporting
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: scandir only via pre-checked native; iterator retained in the ownership ledger before its completion check; per-entry checked enumeration; one close in finally even on BaseException; iterator close failures in resources.unresolved (kind iterator) + unresolved_total + owning cause; enumeration primary kept as NATIVE_EXCEPTION event and owning cause; effective release requires live==0 and unresolved_total==0.
codex_v2_findings.residual: Relies on CPython fd-based scandir dup/rewind semantics (source reasoning).

codex_v2_findings.finding: Registry close BaseException skips cleanup of another owned descriptor
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: release() makes one close attempt per owned handle in reverse order, continues after BaseException, re-raises the FIRST BaseException after all attempts; registry closed flag pre-set False; commit-phase BaseException fires P5_BASE_EXCEPTION, chains pending context and propagates with an in-memory HELD parent_release_result; partial files/lines preserved.
codex_v2_findings.residual: Python exception chaining keeps one context chain; later close failures are retained in the unresolved ledger/event log rather than as chained exceptions.

codex_v2_findings.finding: Artifact validation failure disables commit-directory exclusion
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: job_dir validated independently of the declared map; commit_dir equal to OR below job_dir, or job_dir unavailable/invalid => P5_COMMIT_DIR_INVALID and commit_dir None (in-memory HELD, no disposition/registry I/O).
codex_v2_findings.residual: Malformed specs lose on-disk HELD evidence by design; the allocation stays held.

codex_v2_findings.finding: Root insertion bypasses the global tree-entry cap
codex_v2_findings.mechanism: Same MAX_TREE_ENTRIES check immediately after every root insertion; helper inherits it.

v3_scope_required_items.required: Final assembled result same-original-deadline completion check before return, no further I/O on failure
Completion checks after every native blocking success/Exception; retain primary plus secondary timing failures
Protected scandir acquisition, iterator ownership and one close, retained unresolved history
Nested cleanup ensures every owned descriptor gets at most one close even on BaseException; propagate afterward with evidence
Retain independent job-dir destination exclusion even when another artifact field invalid
Count root insertion toward tree-entry cap
